title: ALINA v1 product shell implementation
goal: Render the first real ALINA Control Center v1 shell from the M1.1 product-shell contract.
why: Move from engineering laboratory surfaces to a product-first default experience while preserving all diagnostic engines behind a developer surface.
constraints: Default route is product UI, not Engineering Lab
All synthetic information is visibly labeled DEMO/MOCK
Core mode remains usable without WebGL
acceptanceCriteria: Security, Presentation and Focus visibly alter primary context and avatar state
Core tier degrades Presentation avatar to portrait while keeping visualization
Engineering diagnostics are closed by default but accessible
CI passes typecheck, tests, build, quality budget, shell contract validation and visual QA
